value:
HV SCREEN 2 IS IMPLEMENTED AS 'EXACTLY ONE IMPURE CLUSTER', SO IT REJECTS FUNCTIONS WITH **ZERO** IMPURE CLUSTERS -- THE ENTIRE PURE-RECOLOR AND PURE-FORM POPULATION. EVERY CENSUS PASS IN THIS FAMILY (HV, CN, CH RUN-25) INHERITED THAT FILTER, SO THAT POPULATION HAD NEVER BEEN SCREENED BY ANY OF THEM. THIS PASS SCREENED IT AND IT IS NOW DECIDED AND EMPTY. Both halves matter: the gap was real, and closing it yields nothing, so no future lane should reopen it.

THE GAP. cn_census.scan_function keeps a function only when exactly one cluster holds a non-register-field word. That is exactly right for the permute+recolor class it was written for, but a function whose every differing word is a pure register-field difference has ZERO such clusters and is filed as ineligible by the same test that filters noise. The image-wide run-26 classification finds 92 functions with `other == 0`; the survivor list those passes worked from contains 39 functions and, by construction, almost none of the 92.

WHY IT LOOKED LIKE NOTHING WAS MISSING: 82 of the 92 are ALREADY SHIPPED as webfrank rules. They are visible in the scan only because it reads RAW bodies, which is the canary property CN identified. So the population appeared to be handled, and the 10 unshipped members were never separated out.

THE 10 UNSCREENED CANDIDATES, EACH DRIVEN THROUGH apply_patch WITH THE MINIMAL RULE (equivalent_copy_form where a form site exists, else copy_register_fields alone), ALL TEN REFUSED, EACH WITH A NAMED CAUSE. Nothing here needs a new mechanism and nothing here is a near miss.
  BASE-REGISTER PRESENCE (5) -- semantic, never forcible, the class recorded as (b) in claim.CH_composed-census-derived-order-closes-the-single-window-population.20260901.v1: psfx::LoadPdataFile +0x118 (g0 vs g23), critter::CritterLoadDone +0x98 (g3 vs g0), critter::CritterLoadStartNext +0xe0 (g3 vs g0), attract::scroll_credits +0xe4 (g25 vs g0), gamemain::fn_80054E78 +0x154 (g0 vs g29). In a D-form instruction rA=0 is the literal zero, not GPR 0, so these are structural differences, not renamings.
  INCONSISTENT RENAMING (4) -- verify_consistent_recolor correctly refuses a non-bisimulation: controls::InitControls +0x2c (g3), movieplayer::fn_800DBE98 +0x3c (f0 vs f2, an FPR), tower::towerRecordLevelBeaten +0x20 (g30 vs g31), tower::TowerCheckMessages +0x5ac (g27 vs g30).
  BRANCH-TARGET BAR (1) -- controls::MtapOpenPort, single fwd form site, refused with '+0xac is a branch target: control can enter between the definition and the rewrite site'. THIS INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCES THE MtapOpenPort REFUSAL RECORDED IN claim.law.DC_copy-form-class-is-directional-and-its-inverse-population-is-unserved.20260901.v1, reached from the opposite direction (that record generalised it to jumptable case-entries), which is corroboration that prove_constant_source's fail-closed behaviour is stable.

TWO TRANSFERABLE RULES. (1) A SCREEN WRITTEN FOR A CLASS SILENTLY DEFINES THAT CLASS'S COMPLEMENT AS INELIGIBLE. `!= 1` was correct for its purpose and wrong as a census, and it propagated through three passes unexamined because each inherited the previous pass's script. When reusing a filter for a NEW question, re-read its rejection branches against the new question -- the bug is never in the branch that fires, it is in the branch that silently returns None. (2) A DECIDED-AND-EMPTY POPULATION IS A DELIVERABLE. The 10 refusals are recorded individually with offsets so the set is not re-probed; five of them fall in a class the project has already ruled permanently unforcible, which is why the yield is zero rather than merely small.
